import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# 1. Price distribution by sensor type
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
sensor_order = df.groupby('sensor_type')['price_usd'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index
sns.boxplot(data=df, y='sensor_type', x='price_usd', order=sensor_order, palette='Set2')
ax1.set_xlabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Price Distribution by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 2. Megapixels vs Price colored by sensor type
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
for sensor in df['sensor_type'].unique():
    sensor_data = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax2.scatter(sensor_data['megapixels'], sensor_data['price_usd'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=30, label=sensor)
ax2.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Megapixels vs Price by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper left')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. 4K Video capability by body type
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
video_by_body = df.groupby('body_type')['has_video_4k'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
video_by_body['percentage'] = (video_by_body['sum'] / video_by_body['count'] * 100).round(1)
video_by_body = video_by_body.sort_values('percentage', ascending=True)
bars = ax3.barh(video_by_body.index, video_by_body['percentage'], color='steelblue')
ax3.set_xlabel('4K Video Capability (%)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('4K Video Capability by Body Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (idx, row) in enumerate(video_by_body.iterrows()):
    ax3.text(row['percentage'] + 1, i, f"{row['percentage']:.1f}%", 
            va='center', fontsize=8)

# 4. Camera evolution over time
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
yearly_stats = df.groupby('model_year').agg({
    'megapixels': 'mean',
    'price_usd': 'mean'
}).reset_index()
ax4_twin = ax4.twinx()
line1 = ax4.plot(yearly_stats['model_year'], yearly_stats['megapixels'], 
                marker='o', color='blue', linewidth=2, label='Avg Megapixels')
line2 = ax4_twin.plot(yearly_stats['model_year'], yearly_stats['price_usd'], 
                     marker='s', color='red', linewidth=2, label='Avg Price')
ax4.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Megapixels', fontsize=10, color='blue')
ax4_twin.set_ylabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=10, color='red')
ax4.set_title('Camera Evolution Over Time', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='blue')
ax4_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='red')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 5. Weight vs Price by body type
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
body_types = df['body_type'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', len(body_types))
for i, body in enumerate(body_types):
    body_data = df[df['body_type'] == body]
    ax5.scatter(body_data['weight_grams'], body_data['price_usd'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=30, label=body, color=colors[i])
ax5.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Weight vs Price by Body Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper left')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Top brands by count and average price
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
brand_stats = df.groupby('brand').agg({
    'price_usd': 'mean',
    'model_year': 'count'
}).rename(columns={'model_year': 'count'})
brand_stats = brand_stats.nlargest(10, 'count')
x_pos = np.arange(len(brand_stats))
bars = ax6.bar(x_pos, brand_stats['count'], color='teal', alpha=0.7)
ax6.set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Models', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Top 10 Brands by Model Count', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax6.set_xticklabels(brand_stats.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
for i, (idx, row) in enumerate(brand_stats.iterrows()):
    ax6.text(i, row['count'] + 2, f"{int(row['count'])}", 
            ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

plt.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis Dashboard', 
            fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
